headline: Central Bank of The Gambia Mandates Replacement of Foreign Staff
summary: The Central Bank of The Gambia has ordered commercial banks operating in the country to replace non-Gambian employees with Gambian nationals by December 31, 2026.
why: The Central Bank of The Gambia regulates the country's banking sector and monetary policy. Workforce localization mandates can affect operational costs and staffing strategies for commercial banks.
